description: Defines the ReportingCacheImpl class implementing the ReportingCache interface for managing reporting reports, endpoints, clients, and related data structures in the Chromium project. Contains class declarations, data members, and method signatures for report and endpoint management.

classes.name: ReportingCacheImpl
classes.description: Implements the ReportingCache interface, managing reports, endpoints, clients, and related data structures for reporting in Chromium. Contains methods for adding, retrieving, removing, and updating reports and endpoints, as well as internal data management and consistency checks.

classes.name: ReportingCacheImpl::Client
classes.description: Represents a client configuration for a (NIK, origin) pair, including endpoint groups and usage metadata.
